name: Overwatch Protocols
description: Guards engage hostiles 35 units farther out and prioritize Runners.

description: Guards deal +25% firearms damage and shots pierce through one extra zombie.

name: Suppressing Fire
description: Ranged hits slow target movement by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

description: Medics revive downed survivors in 2.5s and treat clinic patients 40% faster.

name: Emergency Sutures
description: Revived survivors immediately regain 50% max HP instead of standard 20%.

description: Clinic automatically dispenses immunity treatments; survivors recover while walking.

description: Engineers recover 50% more metal when dismantling or salvaging breaches.

description: Repairs continue even while structures are under zombie attack without interruption.

description: Engineers reinforce all walls with 40% explosive and Bloater burst resistance.

description: Increases daily farm crop growth by +30% across all farm plots.

name: Winter Crop Synthesis
description: Farms produce full food harvests even during harsh winter frost.

name: Master Lockpicking
